what: PhysioWearable: Free-Living Wearable Accelerometry for the Physio Ecosystem — PhysioWearable-package
title: PhysioWearable: Free-Living Wearable Accelerometry for the Physio Ecosystem — PhysioWearable-package
text: Free-living physical-activity analysis raw tri-axial accelerometer data, following GGIR methodology. Computes Euclidean-Norm-Minus-One (ENMO) acceleration metric epoch aggregation, gravity-based auto-calibration (van Hees et al. 2014), non-wear detection, step detection, physical-activity intensity classification bout detection, free-living physical-behaviour summary (intensity gradient MX metrics, activity fragmentation, diurnal profile guideline attainment) linked ICF Activities Participation performance qualifier. Ingests raw accelerometer exports (GENEActiv / ActiGraph / Axivity CSV) PhysioExperiment objects.

title: Gravity-based accelerometer auto-calibration — autoCalibrateAccel
text: Estimates per-axis gain offset force acceleration magnitude 1 g still periods, following GGIR sphere-fitting method (van Hees et al. 2014). Still (non-movement) windows identified low per-axis standard deviation; mean orientations lie unit sphere ideally-calibrated device, gain/offset fitted iteratively projecting onto sphere. Correction (accel - offset) * scale.

title: Train an ADL activity recogniser from labelled windows — trainADL
text: features Training features: adlFeatures() data.frame numeric feature matrix (one row per window). labels Activity label per window (length = number windows). k Neighbours vote (default 5). window_sec, overlap Window settings store recognizeADL() can re-extract features consistently (defaults match adlFeatures()). object adl_model. newdata features classify (adlFeatures() data.frame matrix). ... unused.

title: Train an ADL activity recogniser from labelled windows — trainADL
text: adl_model object.

title: Train an ADL activity recogniser from labelled windows — trainADL
code: set.seed(1) fs <- 20; t <- seq(0, 30, 1 / fs) walk <- cbind(0.2 * sin(2 * pi * 1.8 * t), 0.2 * cos(2 * pi * 1.8 * t), 1) sit  <- cbind(rnorm(length(t), 0, 0.01), rnorm(length(t), 0, 0.01), 1) fw <- adlFeatures(walk, fs); fs2 <- adlFeatures(sit, fs) feats <- rbind(fw, fs2) labs <- c(rep("walking", nrow(fw)), rep("sitting", nrow(fs2))) m <- trainADL(feats, labs) m #> <adl_model> kNN(k=5) | 44 training windows | 36 features #>   activities: sitting, walking

title: PhysioWearable 0.5.0
text: Wrist sleep blood-oxygen analysis (Apple Watch research actigraphy). summarizeAppleSleep() turns Apple Watch sleep STAGES (Apple Health export) per-night clinical metrics: time bed, total sleep time, sleep efficiency, WASO, onset latency, awakenings, Core/Deep/REM minutes; nights split configurable gap. coleKripke() scores sleep/wake per-minute activity counts (Cole-Kripke 1992, Webster rescoring), summarizeSleep() reduces sleep/wake series standard metrics. spo2Metrics() computes oximetry indices SpO2 series – mean, nadir, time 90% (T90/CT90) oxygen desaturation index (ODI) – auto-scaling 0-1 fraction percent using timestamps supplied.

title: PhysioWearable 0.4.1
text: adlToICF() now maps remaining self-care activities (washing -> d510, toileting -> d530, grooming -> d520), HAR pipeline ICF-mapping-ready d5 self-care given task-specific training data.

title: PhysioWearable 0.4.0
text: Real-world upper-limb use (self-care performance). upperLimbUse(): field-standard free-living arm-use metrics bilateral wrist accelerometry – Use Ratio, Magnitude Ratio, Bilateral Magnitude, hours use per arm laterality index – sensor (performance) counterpart clinic upper-limb capacity test, mapping ICF d445 (hand arm use), substrate d5 self-care activities.

title: PhysioWearable 0.3.0
text: Sensor-based ADL activity recognition (HAR). adlFeatures(): windowed time/frequency features activity recognition (per-axis vector-magnitude statistics, signal-magnitude area, inter-axis correlations, dominant frequency, spectral energy/entropy, jerk RMS). trainADL() / recognizeADL(): dependency-free, model-agnostic k-nearest-neighbours activity recogniser (swap PhysioML ROCKET / torch model stronger engine). adlBudget() / adlToICF(): recognised-activity time budget map ICF Activities & Participation d-codes (walking -> d450, stairs -> d455, postures -> d415, eating -> d550, housework -> d640, …) performance qualifier – answering “”, complementing summarizeFreeLiving()’s “much / intense”. Validated real UCI HAR dataset.

title: PhysioWearable 0.2.0
text: Free-living physical-behaviour summary ICF linking. summarizeFreeLiving(): day-level person-level free-living metrics top ENMO / intensity primitives – intensity time-use (sedentary/light/MVPA), Rowlands intensity gradient MX metrics, activity fragmentation (ASTP/SATP), diurnal profile, guideline attainment valid-wear-day handling. intensityGradient(), mxMetrics(), activityFragmentation(), diurnalProfile(): component metrics, exported standalone. freeLivingICF(): map metrics ICF Activities & Participation codes stamped performance qualifier (real-world vs clinic capacity).

title: PhysioWearable 0.1.1
text: Added GGIR gold-standard validation (VAL-10). computeENMO() checked GGIR’s ENMO (GGIR::g.applymetrics) real Axivity AX3 device recording (GGIRread), reproducing numerical precision; GGIR reference bundled (tests/testthat/fixtures/wearable-ggir-reference.rds, regenerated data-raw/wearable_ggir_reference.R) raw file read GGIRread test time. autoCalibrateAccel() (van Hees et al. 2014) validated ground-truth recovery known miscalibration sphere-covering still data cross-checked independent algebraic ellipsoid fit. GGIR/GGIRread added Suggests.

title: PhysioWearable 0.1.0
text: Initial release: ENMO, gravity-based auto-calibration, non-wear detection, step detection, raw-accelerometer /O.
